activities.title: Advertise machine-readable capabilities
activities.description: bodesign_init returns a structured capability summary (transport / ingress / egress / webdav_state / companion_skill / conditional_tool_families) with service-vs-host endpoint flags, alongside the existing prose doctrine (R17.1.1/.1.2).

activities.title: Serve portable resource egress
activities.description: resources/list + resources/read expose every token-produced blob as bodesign://files/<token>/<rel> so a bare MCP client retrieves deliverables with no host-private extension (R17.2.2 portable floor).

activities.title: Inspect workspace before transform
activities.description: A list/status/probe tool enumerates a token namespace tree and proves expected assets exist before any mutation/render (R17.2.3).

activities.title: Preflight + assert delivery
activities.description: Typed asset preflight rejects unresolved / missing-media / out-of-namespace / host-only-absolute paths before render/emit/assemble; content-assertion refuses transport-valid-but-empty artifacts as delivery-ready (R17.2.4/.2.5).

activities.title: Nudge skipped-contract walls
activities.description: A single-source wall-nudge detector fingerprints a skipped-companion-skill wall from the toolcall itself and enriches the error (hard) or attaches a non-blocking hint (advisory), projected onto the portable content-text remedy surface (R0.6).
